---
title: "About"
---

My name is Juan Franco. I currently work as a Senior Data Analyst at Royal
Caribbean Group, and I am completing a master's degree in Business Analytics at
Boston University.

My primary interests lie in data science and machine learning. The program at BU
has provided me with an excellent opportunity to learn about these fields, gain
exposure to them, and, most importantly, develop hands-on experience in both
areas. After completing the program, I plan to apply the skills I have learned
more extensively in my current role and add significant value to my team.

I also hope to continue expanding my knowledge in other closely related areas of
technology, including software engineering. Overall, I consider myself a very
curious person and a lifelong learner who enjoys understanding how things work.
Therefore, I hope to continue learning and applying my knowledge even after
completing my master's degree.
